blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 11.6.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein alkenes ke naam (11.6.1), un ko banane ke tareeqe (11.6.2) aur un ki physical properties parhenge. Alkenes mein carbon-carbon double bond (C=C) hota hai aur un ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ hai.

blocks.prompt: Alkene mein utne hi carbons wale alkane se do hydrogen kam kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon-carbon double bond banane mein dono carbons ki aik aik bond ki jagah istemal hoti hai jo alkane mein hydrogen atoms ke paas thi. Is liye CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ ki jagah CₙH₂ₙ: ethane C₂H₆ aur ethene C₂H₄.

items: Alkenes: C=C wale unsaturated hydrocarbons, CₙH₂ₙ, alkane se do H kam.
